rules.statement: Every Dockerfile `FROM` line names both the image tag and the `@sha256:` digest of its multi-architecture index, never a tag alone.
rules.why: A tag moves when the registry repoints it, so two builds of one commit can differ and a compromised or broken tag can reach the image without review. The index digest pins the layers for every platform.
rules.check: Look for `FROM image:tag` with no `@sha256:` digest, a digest with no tag beside it, or a digest of a single platform manifest instead of the multi-arch index.

rules.statement: Do not build a Dockerfile `FROM` reference from an `ARG` (for example a `NODE_VERSION` or `DOTNET_VERSION` build argument); write the image reference as a literal.
rules.why: Dependabot cannot update a `FROM` built from an `ARG`, and the digest overrides any tag or version the argument names, so the argument would name an image the build does not use.
rules.check: Look for `ARG` declarations used inside `FROM` lines, such as `FROM node:${NODE_VERSION}-slim@sha256:...`.

rules.statement: Digest-pinned Docker base images are tracked by a Dependabot `docker` update entry that stays active even while version updates for other ecosystems are paused.
rules.why: A digest pin only gets operating-system and runtime fixes through Dependabot, so without that stream the image stays on the layers of the day it was pinned.
rules.check: When a diff adds digest pins or changes `.github/dependabot.yml`, check that a `docker` ecosystem entry covers the Dockerfile's directory and that it is not removed or paused.

rules.statement: The Dependabot `docker` entry ignores `version-update:semver-major`, so major versions of a base image only change in a deliberate edit.
rules.why: A runtime major should move deliberately, together with the target framework or the pinned tool version, not through an automatic update.
rules.check: Check that the `docker` entry in `.github/dependabot.yml` has an ignore rule for `version-update:semver-major` and that the rule is not removed.

rules.statement: Leave the `# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1` frontend directive unpinned rather than adding a digest to it.
rules.why: The frontend is the build's parser and never ships in the image. Dependabot cannot update a pin of it, so a digest would freeze the parser with nothing to update it.
rules.check: Look for `# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1@sha256:...` or any other digest-pinned syntax directive.

rules.statement: When a Dockerfile base-image major must match a version pinned somewhere else (for example a `.node-version` file), write the major as a literal in the Dockerfile and change both files in the same change.
rules.why: The single version pin stays the source, and a CI check fails the build when the Dockerfile's literal disagrees with it.
rules.check: Look for a change to the version pin file without a matching change to the Dockerfile `FROM` major, or the reverse.
